name: Server Hosting Tycoon
description: Build a server-hosting empire right inside luma. Buy rigs and routers, spec them with real CPUs, motherboards, RAM and cooling, host services, accept contracts, and manage power and bandwidth as you grow day by day. Now with a phone-friendly layout, offline earnings, a six-branch research tree, daily goals and timed boosts.
details:
A compact datacenter tycoon, built for phone and desktop alike. Start with a single rig and a starter budget, then grow a hosting business one day at a time.

Spec every machine from a real catalog of CPUs, motherboards, RAM, storage, PSUs, cooling and NICs — with socket, RAM-type and power validation so builds actually have to make sense. Host services, accept company contracts for steady income, keep an eye on CPU/RAM/bandwidth bottlenecks and thermals, and buy licenses to unlock new lines of business.

Research is a six-branch tree paid for in research points earned each day, so upgrades take time as well as money — tune kernels and hypervisors for more CPU, compress storage, shape packets, chill your racks, or build out an R&D lab to research faster. Roll daily goals for extra cash, buy timed boosts when you need a push, and set the day clock to 1×, 2× or 4× (or let it auto-advance). Your fleet keeps earning while the app is closed, and a "while you were away" summary is waiting when you come back. Everything saves automatically.
